items.title: I genuinely believe last night was Mitchell Robinson's best and most encouraging game with the Celtics.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
I genuinely believe last night was Mitchell Robinson's best and most encouraging game with the Celtics.

The reasons for that went beyond the box score and punishing screens like the one he set on Caleb Wilson on the first play of the game.

Fans need to stay patient. Throughout his career...1/2
